name: elevator-doors-gallery
title: Elevator Doors Gallery
description: Each photo is a floor behind elevator doors. Press a floor button on the side panel: the doors slide shut, the indicator counts floors with a travel light, and the doors open on the new photo with its floor, title and caption. 'Step inside' zooms the photo out of the doorway to fill the card; click or Escape to return.
darkMode: fully shadcn tokens (card, muted, foreground, background, border, ring, chart-1) with dark: variants - follows the theme
mainProps: items: {src, title?, caption?, alt?, floor? (number or text like 'B1')}[], floor/defaultFloor/onFloorChange, inside/onInsideChange, onStepInside, autoplay, interval, initialDelay, labels (translate all UI text), plus any <div> props
notes: A card, max-w 560px: elevator + 2-column button panel side by side above 480px, stacked below. Needs Tailwind v4 (@container, border-current/50) and React 19 (ref as prop, inert). 4-10 floors look best. `labels` makes it easy to localise (Arabic etc.). Great for hotels, venues, office buildings, real estate.
